tickets.title: Compare Teacup Comet fixed-rate refinance with the variable home-equity line
tickets.text: Compare the Teacup Comet fixed-rate refinance quote with keeping the Copperwisp home-equity line, including payment, closing costs, and cash-flow effect.
tickets.evidence: Agreed by 2025-07-25: compare the Teacup Comet fixed-rate refinance quote with keeping the variable home-equity line, including payment, closing costs, cash-flow effect.

tickets.title: Prepare debt-priority schedule for the Copperwisp household
tickets.text: Prepare a debt-priority schedule weighing Daren Copperwisp’s business line moving off promotional pricing, the home-equity line, and the $18,400 credit-card balance before the higher payment begins.
tickets.evidence: Agreed by 2025-08-08: a debt-priority schedule weighing Daren’s business line moving off promotional pricing, the home-equity line, and the $18,400 credit-card balance before the higher payment begins.
